# Project Phoenix v31.0 WP35 (pure-additive, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v310_wp35_great_powers_and_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Bilateral Trade Treaty: Grain Supply Compact (谷物粮运协约)
oe_wp35_treaty_grain = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		at_war = no
		gold >= 80
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_grain }
	}
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			current_year >= 1337
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
			num_locations >= 1
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			gold >= 40
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_grain }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_wp35_treaty_grain_cd
		years = 15
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_trade }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_grain }
			OR = {
				scope:actor = {
					any_owned_location = {
						OR = {
						raw_material ?= goods:wheat
						raw_material ?= goods:rice
						raw_material ?= goods:millet
						}
					}
				}
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
					raw_material ?= goods:wheat
					raw_material ?= goods:rice
					raw_material ?= goods:millet
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -40
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_grain years = 15 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_grain years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_trade_treaty }
			}
		}
	}
	diplo_chance = {
		base = 15
		opinion = 0.25
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 180
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient value >= 25 }
				}
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}

			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -40
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_salt_fish years = 15 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_salt_fish years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_trade_treaty }
			}
		}
	}
	diplo_chance = {
		base = 15
		opinion = 0.25
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 180
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient value >= 25 }
				}
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}

# Bilateral Trade Treaty: Porcelain & Fine Glass Guild Accord (瓷器琉璃精品商约)
oe_wp35_treaty_luxury_porcelain = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		at_war = no
		gold >= 80
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_luxury_porcelain }
	}
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			current_year >= 1337
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
			num_locations >= 1
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			gold >= 40
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_luxury_porcelain }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_wp35_treaty_luxury_porcelain_cd
		years = 15
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_trade }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { has_discovered = prev.capital }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_luxury_porcelain }
			OR = {
				scope:actor = {
					any_owned_location = {
						OR = {
						raw_material ?= goods:porcelain
						raw_material ?= goods:glass
						raw_material ?= goods:lacquerware
						}
					}
				}
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
					raw_material ?= goods:porcelain
					raw_material ?= goods:glass
					raw_material ?= goods:lacquerware
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -40
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_luxury_porcelain years = 15 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_treaty_luxury_porcelain years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_trade_treaty }
			}
		}
	}
	diplo_chance = {
		base = 15
		opinion = 0.25
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 180
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient value >= 25 }
				}
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}
